title: Resources
section: Brief measures of affective polarization: Shiny app
text:
Brief measures of affective polarization: Shiny app
An interactive tool for choosing combinations of political parties that yield brief, valid measures of affective polarization in multi-party systems, based on CSES Module 5 data. It accompanies Kasper, Schumacher, & Bakker (2025) in the European Journal of Political Research (DOI).
Open the Shiny app

title: Resources
text:
Data visualization workshop (ggplot2)
Slides from a workshop on data visualization in the social and cognitive sciences, taught with Olaf Borghi at the IP-PAD network training day in Amsterdam, November 2025. It covers the plots that come up most in our fields, an introduction to ggplot2, and visualization best practices.
Download slides (PDF)
